description:
As a cemetery administrator (logged-in user)
    I want to search for plots using advanced search with full access
    So that I can manage and find plot information efficiently

elements.name: Advanced search plot by Section, Row, and Number - A A 1

steps.name: I am on the Chronicle login page
I enter email "<TEST_EMAIL>"
I enter password "<TEST_PASSWORD>"
I click the login button
I should be logged in successfully
I navigate to organization home page
I navigate to the cemetery map page
I click Advanced search button
I select section "A" in advanced search
I select row "A" in advanced search
I enter plot number "1" in advanced search
I click Search button in advanced search
I should see search results containing "A A 1"
I click on plot "A A 1" from search results
I should see plot sidebar with plot ID "A A 1"
I should see plot details sidebar
